description.value: Newton Cove Resort is a remote, all-inclusive floating fishing lodge in Esperanza Inlet, operated by Nootka Marine Adventures and reachable only by boat or floatplane. The lodge offers luxury suites, gourmet multi-course meals, guided salmon and halibut fishing, and moorage for guests arriving by private boat. It caters primarily to sport fishing groups, families, and corporate retreats.

address.value: Newton Cove, Esperanza Inlet, Tahsis, BC V0P 1X0, Canada
